text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text in a meaningful way. One common use is translation, where tools like Google Translate turn words from one language into another. NLP is also used for sentiment analysis, which means spotting whether a message is positive, negative or neutral. This helps companies understand what customers think about their products. Another popular example is chatbots, which can answer questions and talk with people online. Thanks to NLP, these systems are becoming smarter and more helpful every day.
